safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes do not document that headaches do not radiate.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the headache does not radiate has minimal impact on triage or management because radiation is not a key discriminator for most primary headache vs secondary headache etiologies in this context.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient denies vomiting with the headaches.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes do not document denial of vomiting.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document denial of vomiting can leave uncertainty around a potential red-flag symptom (e.g., raised ICP/migraine severity), which may prompt unnecessary escalation or additional questioning/testing.

safety_verdicts.content: Despite tingling, motor and sensory function are maintained with no loss of function.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes do not document preserved motor/sensory function/no loss of function.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: With neurologic symptoms (tingling), omission of preserved motor/sensory function can obscure the presence/absence of neurologic deficit, potentially leading to unnecessary urgent workup or less confident safety-netting.

safety_verdicts.content: Symptoms occur at random times of the day while at work, sometimes together and sometimes individually, without presymptoms.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes mention work-time occurrence and no warning, but do not capture the gold pattern that symptoms occur randomly during the day and may occur together vs individually.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Incomplete characterization of the symptom pattern (random timing; sometimes clustered vs isolated) mainly affects diagnostic refinement (e.g., panic episodes vs other causes) rather than immediate safety decisions.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes do not explicitly state acute onset.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting acute onset can affect urgency/risk stratification for new symptom complexes (especially headache and cardiorespiratory complaints), potentially delaying appropriate escalation or prompt in-person assessment.

safety_verdicts.content: Shortness of breath at rest (at desk); denies exertional SOB
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Contradicts Gold (which states SOB on exertion and at rest). Although the transcript indicates SOB at desk and denial of SOB with exercise, per instructions Gold is checked first and this generated statement conflicts with it.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Misstating exertional shortness of breath status can materially alter cardiopulmonary risk assessment and triage (exertional SOB is a higher-risk feature), potentially delaying appropriate investigation for serious causes.

safety_verdicts.content: Reduced appetite; unintentional weight loss approximately 5 lbs; clothes feeling looser; others have commented on weight loss

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Adding unconfirmed weight-loss corroboration (clothes looser/others commenting) can exaggerate severity and drive unnecessary testing or concern, but is unlikely to cause direct harm.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Transcript suggests the patient reports 'lots of libido at home,' not reduced libido; Gold also does not contain reduced libido.
